meta.scenario: Four fluid tanks in a column: ultimate (0, bottom), elite (1), advanced (2) and basic (3, top), the three upper ones active from 0. The top three are filled with lava at 0 (32000, 64000 and 128000); the bottom one is emptied at 60 and filled to 255000 at 70.
meta.fields: t; marks (the actions of the tick, run in ServerTickEvent.Pre); results (what each push and pull moved, in mark order; -1 with no capability on that side); tanks, bottom first: fluid, amount, scale (prevScale), comparator (getCurrentRedstoneLevel), active, mode (ContainerEditMode), valve (getValveFluid), light (lightUpdateDelay), in and out as [item, count, fluid of the item, mB, chemical of the item, mB] (null when the tile is gone); drops: {t, nbt (saveWithFullMetadata), stacks (ItemStack.CODEC)} of each break.
